maria: Quick sync — from the postmortem for INC-3245 we saw a repeating cache-eviction pattern during autoscaling. Need concrete owners for remediation items and specific triage commands we can add to the operational checklist. I’ll propose owners below; please claim or suggest edits.

alex: I can take the triage checklist edits + the short doc with commands.

maria: Thanks. High-level outcomes we need to track: short-term doc + commands, medium-term alerting + play, long-term autoscaler tuning and tests.

sam: For the short-term doc, what exact command(s) should be copied into the checklist to diagnose eviction quickly? I only remember seeing compressed logs.

alex: Use these two quick queries/commands: 
```
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --tail=200 | grep evict
# and metric query (Prometheus/Redwood metrics):
redwood-metrics query 'max(redis_evictions{shard=~".*"})'
```
Add a step: collect pod mem/cpu at the time (kubectl top pods).

lee: I’ll own the alert + escalation leg (PagerDuty + #incidents). Target: EOD Tue. Assigning to @lee.

incidents-bot: New action created: ACTION-4823 assigned to lee, due 2256792000

maria: Owners + deadlines (draft):
- alex: update triage checklist with commands + open PR to docs (due 2256791000)
- lee: create PD alert + slack incident play (due 2256792000)
- sam: add a heavy scale-up integration test that reproduces eviction pattern (due 2256850000)
- alex: follow up with infra on autoscaler config (C groups) and propose a canary tweak (due 2256860000)

sam: I can prototype the test by Monday, will post progress in this thread.

devops-bot: Reminder — oncall rotation changes tomorrow; sustained eviction pages will go to @oncall.

oncall: Acknowledged. I’ll run alex’s commands when paged and post logs + timeline here.

maria: To avoid duplication: if you edit the 'triage-checklist' doc, please put "ACTION-4823" in the PR description and tag the owners so the postmortem dashboard links correctly.

alex: Will open the PR in ~1h and assign reviewers (cc @lee).

lee: +1 :thumbsup:

maria: I’ll schedule a 15m follow-up Wed to confirm triage scripts landed and tests started. If any item slips past deadlines, we escalate to infra leads for capacity to complete.

alex: noted, will update PR with test notes.

incidents-bot: ACTION-4823 status: in_progress (owner: alex, lee, sam).
